descriptive_title: Grade 2 Mathematics: Numbers — Addition and Subtraction Facts to 20, Mental Strategies and Modelling to 100, Multiplication as Repeated Equal Groups, and Division as Equal Sharing (B2.1–B2.6)
short_description: A 5-day Ontario Grade-2 unit on Numbers (B2.1-B2.6), framed around Mae the Multiplier and Dan the Divider running 'The Equal Groups Workshop'. Fact recall to 20, mental strategies, story-problem modelling to 100, multiplication as repeated equal groups (including halves and fourths), and division as equal sharing all in one focused week.
long_description: Children spend a focused week as Junior Equal Groups Builders. Day 1 'Big Sums to 20' anchors fact recall to 20 with doubles, near-doubles, make-ten, and the chunk-by-tens upgrade for sums to 50 (B2.2, B2.3). Day 2 'Story Problems to 100' is the modelling lesson with the build-draw-write-check pipeline, teaching the addition-subtraction relationship through check-by-reversing (B2.4, B2.1). Day 3 'Equal Groups — Mae's Multiplication Move' introduces multiplication as repeated equal groups using paper kittens in baskets and array grids (B2.5). Day 4 'Half-Groups and Fourth-Groups' tackles the trickier B2.5 case: 4 × 1/2 = 2, 6 × 1/4 = 1½. Day 5 'Equal Sharing — Dan's Division Move' closes with division-as-equal-sharing using paper plates and fact-family triangles connecting multiplication to division (B2.6, B2.1). Each lesson includes a 4000+ char expanded_walkthrough covering 3 misconceptions paired with concrete recovery moves; mid-unit and end-of-unit assessments included.
what_is_included: 5 fully-scripted lesson plans with 50-minute durations and 250 minutes of total teaching time
5 student worksheets aligned to each lesson with name/date fields and child-voice learning goals
1 mid-unit formative assessment (Multiplication Check-In) administered between Lessons 3 and 4

13 printable teacher manipulatives plus 3 character puppets: double ten-frame mat, two-colour counters label, paper kittens (20), baskets template, story problem cards (18), array grid mat, paper cookies with halves and fourths (24), share plates label, multiplication/division fact triangles (24), the Equal Groups Workshop anchor poster, plus stick-puppet variants of Mae, Dan, and Buddy
1 end-of-unit reflection sheet with 5 self-assessment prompts
1 six-row summative rubric covering B2.1-B2.6 across 4 levels
1 summative-administration guide tying the rubric to Lesson 5 worksheet
Junior Equal Groups Builder certificate (one per child) for the closing ceremony

Detailed expanded walkthroughs for every lesson including the strategy-scale mismatch repair, tape-diagram-as-structure repair, multiplication-as-grouping understanding, fraction-as-whole-number error repair, and build-to-equation translation
Differentiation tracks built into every lesson: emerging learners, extending learners, ELL/IEP, and movement-first learners
target_buyer: Ontario Grade 2 teachers covering the B2.1-B2.6 cluster of the 2026 Grade 2 Math curriculum. Useful as a 5-day unit at the start of the calendar year (October-November) or as a multiplication/division introduction in late winter before report-card cycle.
subject: Mathematics
pedagogical_approach: Concrete-Representational-Abstract progression. Real two-colour counters, paper kittens in baskets, paper cookies with halves and fourths, and paper plates anchor every concept before any abstraction. The keystone Lesson 3 introduces multiplication as visible equal groups; the integration Lesson 4 extends to fractional groups; the capstone Lesson 5 reveals division as the partner of multiplication via fact-family triangles. Differentiation is proactive (built into every lesson) rather than remedial.
